paper_metadata.title: Improved mechanical properties of W-Zr-Ti-Nb alloys via adding Ti and Nb

evidence.quote: In this study, 65 W-Zr-Ti-Nb alloys with different Ti and Nb content were prepared by powder metallurgy.

Homogeneous powder mixtures were achieved through a ball milling process utilizing a planetary ball mill with a weight ratio of balls to powder of 1:1, a milling time of 6 hours, and a rotation rate of 200 rpm.
The powder mixtures were subsequently pressed with a dwell time of 40 minutes and a pressure of 350 MPa.
The powder compact was sintered at a temperature of 1773 K for 300 minutes, within an Ar atmosphere at standard pressure.

the plasticity of the 65 W-Zr-Ti-Nb alloys is obviously higher than of the 65 W-Zr-Ti alloys. The results indicated that the Nb addition plays a key role in improving the plasticity of the alloy.

Both the increased spacing of {110} plane and decreased interatomic bonding strength are beneficial for reducing Peierls-Nabarro stress, thereby promoting plastic deformation of the bcc-structured WTixNby solid solution.
